kurz: Two thin, short biscuits with jam in between: baked pale they stay tender, and boiled-up jam glues them together.
bild_im_kopf: Like a sandwich with a built-in window: the base below, the frame above, the jam glowing in between.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Make a shortcrust with icing sugar and chill it
schluesselmomente.warum: Icing sugar dissolves quickly and makes the dough fine and tender.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Roll out thinly, cut out, and cut a hole in half of them
schluesselmomente.warum: Thin rounds bake through quickly, before they brown.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Bake at about 200 °C for only 6–8 minutes, until still pale (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: Spitzbuben should stay pale: more browning makes them hard and bitter.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Bring the jam briefly to the boil, spread on the bases, add the tops with the hole
schluesselmomente.warum: Hot jam is runny and spreads well. As it cools, the pectin sets again and glues the halves together.
